pages.lesson:
LESSON: HOUSE OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.1: House of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about House of God. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the church a holy place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew :-
2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew :-
   In simple words: practise until you can outline lessons learnt from Matthew :-. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually
   In simple words: practise until you can participate in church activities to grow spiritually. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about House of God using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about House of God in the examples.
2. Explain House of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand House of God.
4. Show that you can: outline lessons learnt from Matthew :-

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about House of God using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is House of God important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Matthew 21:12-13 and list lessons learnt from the Bible text,
2. Read 1Corithinians 14:26 and list activities mentioned in the Bible text,
3. In groups, list the activities they do in church,
4. In pairs, list ways of respecting the church as a house of God,
5. Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners sing a song related to serving God.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew :-
2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
